variants.prompt: On the rooftop at golden hour, bathed in the warm, soft hues of sunset, this statuesque beauty commands attention in a sleek, form-fitting black jumpsuit with metallic accents, cinched at the waist by a studded belt. Her icy blonde mane is styled in effortless, flowing waves, and her porcelain skin glows with a subtle alabaster sheen. Her piercing emerald eyes flash with bold, commanding intensity as she stands at the edge of the rooftop, the city skyline stretching out behind her, the gentle breeze ruffling her hair as she looks directly into the camera lens, her confident posture and fierce gaze captured in the shallow depth of field.
